Holiday Tree Recycling

Holiday tree recycle drop-off sites and dates for 2026-27 will be announced in the Fall. 

Holiday trees only; please no wreaths, garland, yard waste, tree branches or other wood products. These trees will be recycled to provide free mulch to residents and to be used throughout CCOB parks.

The list of drop-off sites are listed below or can be viewed on this map.

Drop-Off Locations

Bronco Park
Westlake Drive and Grove Circle. The tree drop-off is north of the backstop.

Broadlands Park West
Sheridan Boulevard and Meadow Mountain Drive. The tree drop-off is on the northwest side of the parking lot.

Lac Amora Park
Miramonte Boulevard and Oak Circle North. The tree drop-off is north of the playground.

Community Park Ball Fields
Community Park Drive and Spader Way. The tree drop-off is west of George Hall Field.

Broomfield Recycle Center
Industrial Lane and Commerce Street. The tree drop-off is west of the recycle bins.

Meridian Park
McKay Circle and Park Cove Way in McKay Landing. The tree drop-off is located north of the backstop.

Anthem Community Park Parking Lot
Approximately 1/2 mile east of Lowell Boulevard on Sheridan Parkway (not the small parking lot designated for reservoir access). The tree drop-off is located on the east side of the parking lot.

Tree Branch Recycling Facility
2990 W. 124th Avenue. Tree drop-off is located east of the guard shack by the mulch pile.
Wreaths, live garland, yard waste and tree branches can also be dropped off at the tree branch recycling facility.
